title: US Treasury Yield Curve -- parsed with curve-shape signals
description: Parses the US Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve Rates XML feed into clean JSON per date and computes curve-shape signals (2s10s spread, inversion flag, day-over-day change). Public U.S. Treasury data for AI agents and market research; raw data, not advice.
pricing: Pay-per-event, small per-request charge (exact price set at listing time)
disclaimer: This tool reports public U.S. Treasury data as-is. It is not investment advice, makes no prediction, and may contain errors or omissions. Use at your own risk; verify against home.treasury.gov.
requirements:
Implement two pure functions in src/core.js using only Node built-ins (no XML library).

1) parseYieldCurveXml(xmlString) -> array of {date, rates} sorted by date ascending, one per <entry>. date is 'YYYY-MM-DD' taken from the d:NEW_DATE tag (drop the time part). rates maps tenor labels to JS numbers for every d:BC_* tag present: BC_1MONTH->'1M', BC_2MONTH->'2M', BC_3MONTH->'3M', BC_4MONTH->'4M', BC_6MONTH->'6M', BC_1YEAR->'1Y', BC_2YEAR->'2Y', BC_3YEAR->'3Y', BC_5YEAR->'5Y', BC_7YEAR->'7Y', BC_10YEAR->'10Y', BC_20YEAR->'20Y', BC_30YEAR->'30Y'. A tag that is empty or marked m:null="true" is omitted from rates (never NaN). Never throw on missing tags.

2) curveSignals(rows) where rows is the output of parseYieldCurveXml -> {latestDate, spread2s10s, inverted, changeVsPrevious} for the LAST row: spread2s10s = rates['10Y'] - rates['2Y'] rounded to 2 decimals (null if either missing), inverted = spread2s10s < 0 (false if null), changeVsPrevious = object mapping each tenor present in BOTH the last and previous row to (last - previous) rounded to 2 decimals (empty object if only one row).

Also write src/fetch.js exporting an async fetchYieldCurveXml(year, opts) that queries only treasury.gov with a descriptive User-Agent header, returning the raw XML string; dependency-free and not exercised by the offline tests. Keep everything small and readable.
